turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Let us do one together first.
"He eats an apple." I listen to the first sound of apple: "a". It is a vowel sound, so I write an.
Rule: use an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
Right: She has a cat. Wrong: She has an cat.

Now try. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
